newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador vows to pay bonus to the poor at year-end.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador vows to pay bonus to the poor at year-end.

text.p: Ecuadorean Finance Minister Pablo Concha promised Thursday that the administration would give the nation's neediest families a bonus at the end of the year to compensate them for new austerity measures.
Concha said the government would pay the bonus to between 600,000 and 800,000 families, but he declined to quantify the payout.
Ecuadoreans have staged regular protests this year against increases in public service costs and the elimination of subsidies.
Concha cited electricity rates, which recently rose 100 percent after being frozen since 1993.
"There are measures which, however painful, must be taken," he told reporters. ((-- Gustavo Oviedo, Quito newsroom, 5932 258 433))
